header.publisher: KFF State Health Facts (analysis of state exchange data)
header.notes: APPROXIMATION. CT runs a state-based exchange for plan year 2026 and is not in the CMS HealthCare.gov landscape file; no county-level machine-readable benchmark data was ingested. stateAverageAge21 = KFF average benchmark premium for a 40-year-old ($870/month, weighted by county plan selections) / 1.28 (age-40 factor of the applicable age curve). The real benchmark varies by rating area; the app lets the user enter their own SLCSP. sha256 is of the canonical JSON body (file without header).
